record.original_question: Determine conditions under which a global minimizer y* of the nonlinear elastic energy I(y)=∫Ω W(Dy) dx is smooth in Ω and smooth up to the boundary, apart from expected singularities near points where the displacement and traction boundary parts meet.

evidence.quote: Problem 3. When is the minimizer y∗ in Theorem 2.1 smooth?
Here smooth means C ∞ in Ω, and C ∞ up to the boundary

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ ($n=2$ or $3$) be a bounded domain with Lipschitz boundary $\partial \Omega = \overline{\partial_1\Omega} \cup \overline{\partial_2\Omega}$, where $\partial_1\Omega$ and $\partial_2\Omega$ are disjoint relatively open subsets on which displacement (Dirichlet) and traction (Neumann) boundary conditions are imposed respectively. Let $W : \mathbb{R}^{n\times n}_+ \to \mathbb{R}$ be a stored-energy density (smooth on the set of matrices with positive determinant, polyconvex or quasiconvex, satisfying $W(F) \to \infty$ as $\det F \to 0^+$, and coercive in an appropriate Sobolev space sense). Consider the elastic energy
$$I(y) = \int_\Omega W(Dy(x))\, dx - \langle \text{loads}, y\rangle,$$
defined on admissible deformations $y : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}^n$ with $y = y_0$ on $\partial_1\Omega$, $\det Dy > 0$ a.e. Assume the existence of a global minimizer $y^* \in W^{1,p}(\Omega;\mathbb{R}^n)$ of $I$.

Determine geometric and analytic conditions on $W$, $\Omega$, the boundary data, and the loads under which $y^*$ is $C^\infty$ in $\Omega$ and $C^\infty$ up to the boundary except possibly near points of $\overline{\partial_1\Omega} \cap \overline{\partial_2\Omega}$ where displacement and traction boundary regions meet.
artifact.status_search_result: The smoothness of global minimizers of nonlinear elastic energies is a long-standing open problem repeatedly highlighted by Ball and others. Only partial regularity results for general quasiconvex functionals (Evans, Kristensen–Mingione, etc.) are known, and these do not apply directly under the determinant-blow-up condition typical in elasticity. No general resolution has been reported.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in elasticity (Ball)
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 3. When is the minimizer y* smooth? This is a major open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as a major open problem in nonlinear elasticity.

status_evidence.title: Partial regularity for minimizers of quasiconvex integrals
status_evidence.snippet: Partial regularity results for vectorial minimizers; full regularity remains open in general.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial regularity is available; full smoothness is not known.
